author: MeijiHKitty
body: Assumptions are what get you killed. Best way to find out is the game website/wiki, using the codex to see what skill/spells your enemies can use. Or just go old school trial and error, the more you fight something the more you start to remember what it does

author: Sketutz
body:
I complete enemy codex. Yes, it's a pain to do so at first, but you'll never have to open the wiki again to find  simple things like what an enemy is weak/strong against, what drops they have, and status immunities etc.


That's just me and my obsession in completing 'things' tho. If you dont like it since it's another thing to 'grind'. Refer to the wiki, like a normal person :)
